premises.text: Nonprofits are underserved by tech and still rely on pen and paper for scheduling, volunteer tracking, and donations
premises.evidence_span: Many still rely on pen and paper for core processes like scheduling, volunteer tracking, and even donations

premises.text: Volunteers should be treated like retail customers because they give huge service hours and donate far more than non-volunteers
premises.evidence_span: volunteers should be treated no differently than retail customers

premises.text: Civic Champs automates volunteer management via geofenced mobile check-in, kiosk mode, and staff admin check-in
premises.evidence_span: Civic Chance provides automated volunteer management by providing three different ways for nonprofits to track volunteer hours

premises.text: An integrated micro-donations platform converts volunteers to donors at the inspired moment using volunteer data for ask timing, amount, and messaging
premises.evidence_span: launch the integrated micro-donations platform that will allow for nonprofits to automatically convert volunteers to donors

premises.text: Architecture uniquely serves nonprofits, volunteers, and corporations with seamless data sharing across the full market
premises.evidence_span: Civic Champs has a database and technology architecture that's uniquely built to serve the full market, allowing for seamless data sharing between nonprofits, volunteers, and corporations

premises.text: Clients pay $25–$450 monthly in a large nonprofit CRM market expandable to adjacent CSR and donation processing
premises.evidence_span: These clients pay between $25 to $450 a month

domains.name: Monthly SaaS pricing in nonprofit CRM

value.text: Seamless volunteer management that automatically converts volunteers to donors and increases community impact
value.evidence_span: seamless volunteer management and a way to automatically convert your volunteers to donors

secondary_value.text: Help corporations quantify community impact and foundations add agency capacity
secondary_value.evidence_span: whether you're a corporation looking to quantify your community impact, or your foundation looking to add to the capacity of your agencies

notes: Three tracking modes folded into one volunteer-management premise (§4.1(5)). Client count and word-of-mouth growth excluded as traction. Team bio/exits excluded. Need/product/pricing triad justified by separate revisability.
